# TailwindCSS

A Discord Activity template using **TailwindCSS** for utility-first styling.

<Cards>
  <Card href="https://tailwindcss.com/" title="Tailwind CSS" description="Utility-first CSS framework." />
  <Card href="/docs/discord-activities" title="Documentation" description="Getting started with Robo.js" />
</Cards>

## Getting Started

Create a project with this template:

```package-install
npx create-robo <project-name> --template discord-activities/react-tailwind-ts
```

Then navigate into your project directory:

```bash
cd <project-name>
```

Run development mode:

```bash
npm run dev
```

## Features

- TailwindCSS pre-configured
- Dark mode support
- TypeScript support
- Vite-powered development

## Hosting

```bash
npm run deploy
```
